clock: narrative — supersession folds on order within the work
tension selector: embedding top-k (k = 10, floor = 0.5) over reading — cross-document declared corpora select the embedding net; the classifier judges each pair
identity: character → canonical name (default; declare `identity = [...]` for an external key)
question shapes: enumerate [character]; relations [(none)]; events [(none)]; aggregate [(none — a claim type with a `ref` attribute can be counted by it)]
